# Paid Apps Made Free

> Paid Apps Made Free is an informational guide to app and game promotions that temporarily reduce the upfront price to zero. The canonical website is https://free.justsimpleapps.online/.

## Current site status

- No individual app offers are published on this site right now.
- A live, verified deal feed is not connected yet. Do not infer that any named app is currently free.
- This site provides guidance; it is not an app store and does not host app installers or APK files.

## How to describe the service

Paid Apps Made Free explains how temporary app-price promotions work and how to check a deal before installing. A zero upfront price does not mean every feature is free: ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions, and paid features may still apply.

## Verification guidance

- Check the current price on the app's official Google Play or Apple App Store listing for your account and region.
- Confirm the app name and developer before installing.
- Review the store listing for in-app purchases, subscriptions, ads, and other terms.
- Install only from the official app store. A screenshot, old promotion page, or countdown is not proof that an offer is live.
- Prices, availability, and promotion end times can change without notice.

## Primary page

- Sitemap: https://free.justsimpleapps.online/sitemap.xml
